SCG-SQLI-005.title: SQL built from $_GET/$_POST input is injectable; use prepared statements with bound parameters

SCG-TLS-001.title: TLS certificate verification disabled (verify=False / CERT_NONE); keep verification on and point to a private CA bundle instead

SCG-TLS-002.title: TLS certificate verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false); keep verification on and pass the private CA via the ca option

SCG-TLS-003.title: TLS verification switched off process-wide by environment variable (NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 and similar); trust the private CA instead

SCG-TLS-004.title: TLS certificate verification disabled (InsecureSkipVerify: true); configure RootCAs with the private CA instead

SCG-TLS-005.title: Script disables TLS verification (curl -k, wget --no-check-certificate, http.sslVerify=false); trust the private CA with --cacert instead

SCG-TLS-006.title: TLS trust-all certificate or hostname verifier; load the private CA into a TrustManager instead
